sources.purpose: Latest quarterly ownership, corporate-boundary and subsequent-event check
sources.result: The July 29, 2026 Form 10-Q continued to report Puget Energy as the parent of Puget Sound Energy and did not disclose a later sponsor transfer or pending platform sale.

sources.purpose: Current owner-set and canonical parent boundary
sources.result: The 2025 Form 10-K names the six long-term infrastructure owners and states that Puget Energy is the direct parent of PSE.
The May 18, 2026 credit agreement schedule identifies Puget Sound Energy as 100% owned by Puget Energy and Puget LNG as a separate Puget Energy subsidiary.

notes: The latest filings reinforce the Puget Energy parent / PSE subsidiary consolidation boundary and do not change the six-owner cap table.
